name: ModelNoiseScale
plain: Sets a noise multiplier on flow models whose training used noise larger than unit variance. It keeps shift and multiplier and only rebuilds the sampling object.
math: Flow start state becomes σ·(s·n) + (1−σ)·x_lat, s=noise_scale (CONST.noise_scaling reads self.noise_scale, default 1). Tooltip names HiDream-O1 base 8.0, dev 7.5.

props.architectures: Flow samplings with shift and multiplier attributes (type(original)(config); set_parameters(shift,multiplier)). Others raise AttributeError.
